'''Updating items''' refers to the tools [[Matcha Flavoured]] provides for bringing items from older versions of the pack up to date, chiefly the <code>/trigger update_item</code> command added in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2]].

== Background ==
Datapacks cannot add items, so every custom item is a vanilla item with extra data components (name, model, lore, enchantments, attributes). An item keeps the components it was created with, so when a new version changes an item's stats, textures or name, old copies stay as they were and often no longer stack with new ones. In 1.12.2 almost all models and data moved from the <code>minecraft</code> and <code>main</code> namespaces to <code>matcha</code>, which made many old items appear broken.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=So the previous models either minecraft:x or main:x have been moved to matcha:x}}</ref>

== /trigger update_item ==
Hold the item in the main hand and run <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Any player can use it without cheats.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/update_old_items/check_trigger.mcfunction}}</ref> The function:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/update_old_items/update_held_item.mcfunction}}</ref>
# Reads the held item's translation key. If it has none, it reports "The held item cannot be updated because it is missing a translation key."
# Looks the key up in a table of 234 current item definitions, generated from the pack's crafting, smithing and food recipes and villager trades. Unknown items are reported as "cannot be updated".
# Builds the current version of the item, and carries over the stack size, custom name, enchantments, armor trim and lodestone compass target. Durability damage is kept as a proportion of the new maximum.
# Restores each item's intrinsic enchantments to at least their current level, for example Fortune III on an electrum pickaxe.
# Replaces the held item with the new one and reports "The held item has been successfully updated."

The table is generated by the script <code>generate_update_item_mcfunction.py</code> in the repository.<ref>{{Source|generate_update_item_mcfunction.py}}</ref>

== Automatic updates ==
* The sacred texts (The Avesta, The Book of Enoch, The Divine Comedy, The Lesser Key of Solomon, Paradise Lost, The Quran and The Tanakh) and the "Golden" music disc are replaced automatically when picked up, outside Creative mode.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/update_old_items/quran.json}}</ref>
* Vanilla apples, sweet berries and turtle scutes, vanilla water bottles and unenchanted vanilla elytra are converted into the pack's versions.
* When a player joins after an update, their recipe unlocks and most reward [[advancements]] are reset so new recipes can unlock. See [[Advancements#Revocation on update]].

== Other methods ==
* <code>/loot give @s loot matcha:...</code> gives a fresh copy of many items, for example <code>matcha:treasure/divine_comedy</code>.
* Loading the previous resource pack below the new one hides broken textures, although enchantments stay broken.
* The weaponsmith (grindstone villager) melts alloyed equipment into its components, and an [[Amnestic|amnestic]] resets a villager's trades. Both were added in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.10|1.10]].
